guideline: Evaluators scored headlines on three criteria: language (correct Finnish and making sense), usable (matches article without errors), and good (publishable without editing).
Evaluators filled a worksheet marking each headline with 1 (pass) or 0 (fail) for each of the three criteria: language, usable, good.

The criteria are language, usable and good. Language: If disregarding the article text, is the headline on its own correct Finnish? Does this headline make sense to a human being? Usable: Could this headline be used for the given text in the real world? Does it match the text in the news article without misquoting and without errors? Good: Is this headline good enough for the editor to be comfortable publishing the article with it without feeling the need to edit it or come up with variants?
